data.exact_reserve_text: Within this profit, there was a profit arising from the reinsurance to close received from 2012 year of account of GBP 12.7m before expenses and investment return. This arose largely from a reduction in the 2012 and prior year's liability reserves as a result of favourable settlements in 2015.

reduction in the 2012 and prior year's liability reserves as a result of favourable settlements in 2015.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a GBP 12.7 million release in prior year reserves, primarily stemming from a profit arising from the reinsurance to close received from the 2012 year of account. This favorable development was attributed to reductions in liability reserves for 2012 and prior years, resulting from favorable settlements. This contributed to the overall profit for the 2013 closed account.
raw_causal_phrases: a substantial release of reserves for prior years now available due to the continuing and increasingly favourable trends experienced during the last few years in incurred claims development on all years of account
a profit arising from the reinsurance to close received from 2012 year of account of GBP 12.7m before expenses and investment return
a reduction in the 2012 and prior year's liability reserves as a result of favourable settlements in 2015

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure is a gross profit arising from reinsurance to close received, explicitly stated in the Managing Agent's Report. The claims development triangle on page 30, when calculated for years 2013 and prior, shows a smaller net release of -GBP 5.676m, which is not used as the primary PYD figure due to the more specific narrative. The LOB movement is inferred from the narrative for the total PYD.
